related_public_macrocycle_model.relationship: The 2024 NNC2215 article cites this work as reference 4 and states that its macrocycle model was adapted from models shown there.
related_public_macrocycle_model.reported_modeling: The 2019 supplement describes Maestro 10.4/Batchmin 11.0 MCMM models of a receptor surrogate and its glucose complex using MMFFs and OPLS2005 with aqueous GB/SA solvation. It reports figures and methods, not coordinate files, in the reviewed supplement.
related_public_macrocycle_model.boundary: This is a related public model source, not the in-house crystal structure used to seed the 2026 PaG simulation; it does not make the exact 2026 run reproducible.

method_summary.equilibration: Standard equilibration protocol; details are referenced but not fully enumerated in the SI.
method_summary.seed_system: An in-house crystal structure of a macrocycle similar to the one in NNC2215, bound to glucose.
method_summary.glucose_to_pag_setup: A representative snapshot from the macrocycle–glucose 500 ns production run was used to build the macrocycle–PaG starting configuration in Maestro; the same MD protocol was then applied.
method_summary.analysis: Relevant snapshots were extracted to inspect dynamics and intermolecular interactions; the paper also reports NMR observations supporting the proposed conformation.

public_input_status.starting_crystal_coordinates: Not supplied in the article or supporting information; the structure is described as in-house and data not shown.
public_input_status.2024_nnc2215_model_pdbs: Available separately in the Springer Nature Figshare dataset recorded in structure-manifest.json; these are model-built NNC2215 states, not the 2026 study seed structure.
public_input_status.exact_md_rerun: Not reproducible from the currently available public input set.

evidence_note: This JSON paraphrases reported methods and records the input gap. It is not a simulation input deck, a reconstruction of unpublished coordinates, or evidence that MD was rerun.
